# qbittorrent_rss_rule (Resource)

Manage one qBittorrent RSS auto-download rule by name. Import ID is the exact rule name. Changing the name replaces the rule. Match history is computed and carried across updates. When both a deprecated top-level alias and its equivalent torrent_params field are configured, the native torrent_params value takes precedence. Tags are an unordered set and duplicate tags are removed. Updating a rule that already contains nonempty TLS certificate, private-key, or DH-parameter material is rejected because the provider cannot preserve that unsupported material. The resource manages only the rule definition; it does not create or refresh feeds, import/export other rules, or add torrents. Keep RSS fetching and auto-downloading disabled while managing rule configuration if you do not want RSS processing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Keep RSS processing disabled while creating rule configuration. This example
# deliberately has no feeds and does not enable the rule or auto-downloads.
resource "qbittorrent_rss_rule" "example" {
  rule_name        = "Example release rule"
  enabled          = false
  priority         = 0
  use_regex        = true
  must_contain     = "Example"
  must_not_contain = "sample"
  episode_filter   = "S[0-9]+E[0-9]+"
  affected_feeds   = []
  ignore_days      = 0
  smart_filter     = false

  # Null preserves qBittorrent's optional deprecated aliases.
  add_stopped    = null
  content_layout = null

  torrent_params = {
    category       = "tv"
    tags           = ["weekly", "anime"]
    save_path      = "/srv/qbittorrent/downloads"
    stopped        = true
    content_layout = "Subfolder"
    download_limit = 0
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `rule_name` (String) Exact qBittorrent rule name. Changing this replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `add_stopped` (Boolean) Deprecated qBittorrent add-paused alias. Null leaves the optional native value unset.
- `affected_feeds` (List of String) Feed URLs selected by this rule. This does not create or manage RSS feeds.
- `category` (String) Deprecated qBittorrent category alias.
- `content_layout` (String) Deprecated qBittorrent content-layout alias. Allowed values: Original, Subfolder, NoSubfolder. Null leaves the optional native value unset.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether qBittorrent evaluates this rule.
- `episode_filter` (String) Episode filter expression.
- `ignore_days` (Number) Ignore articles older than this number of days.
- `must_contain` (String) Required title text or regular expression.
- `must_not_contain` (String) Excluded title text or regular expression.
- `priority` (Number) Rule priority; qBittorrent uses lower numbered priorities first.
- `save_path` (String) Deprecated qBittorrent save-path alias (server-side path).
- `smart_filter` (Boolean) Apply qBittorrent's smart episode filter.
- `torrent_params` (Attributes) Typed, allowlisted qBittorrent AddTorrentParams values. Secret TLS material and file-selection internals are not supported. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--torrent_params))
- `use_regex` (Boolean) Interpret must_contain and must_not_contain as regular expressions.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) RSS rule name.
- `last_match` (String) Runtime last-match timestamp. Preserved on rule updates.
- `previously_matched_episodes` (List of String) Runtime episode match history. Preserved on rule updates.
